H1_residue.note: SUPPORTED means at least one residue is above its assay median in >=85% of assays where it appears, well beyond the 50% null.

parent_prechecks.note: Attacks Run pre-emptively by the author before the reviewer round, because these are the two ways the headline could be manufactured rather than measured. Recompute them independently if distrusting.

normalisation_cannot_create_the_effect.test: recompute rho on residual_raw (unnormalised) vs residual (per-assay sd)
normalisation_cannot_create_the_effect.conclusion: A per-assay scalar cannot change a within-assay rank correlation. Confirmed exactly, not asserted.

position_effect_is_not_a_count_artefact.test: does r2 relate to pairs-per-position or position count?
position_effect_is_not_a_count_artefact.conclusion: No relationship to either count, so the 0.140 is clustering, not an artefact of how many pairs each position happens to have.
